authorization: Shared VCM retaining other commands; three demo percentages and three complete alarm times; compare something better without changing installed artifacts.
limitations: Not arbitrary numeric/time composition; frozen prior studies and installed defaults unchanged.
Perfect future-speaker recognition is not guaranteed. Phonetic distance is a design heuristic, not acoustic proof.
Old exposed official202 and original DEV/TEST are regression evidence. New declared TEST voice IDs do not prove physical voice independence from opaque historical synthesis.
No microphone, actions, ASR, LLM or cloud recognition. Cloud synthesis is development-only.

negative_prompts: Set an alarm for six p m
Set an alarm for twelve thirty a m
Set an alarm for nine forty five a m
Set an alarm for eight a m
Set an alarm for nine p m
Do not set volume to fifty percent
Do not set an alarm for six a m

training.initialization: random; same seed and initial encoder weights; no pretrained slot-head transplant
training.augmentation: Frozen legacy feature-domain train augmentation; same sampled IDs/NumPy sequence in matched fits.

selection.population: DEV only; supported-only ranking; never TEST
selection.retention_guard: Retained-supported human DEV correct count >= unchanged parent raw correct count on the same scope and recording IDs. No OOS veto.
ranking: mean(retained-human supported accuracy, new-demo-slot complete macro accuracy)
negative count of wrong supported slots
selection.fallback: If neither candidate passes retention guard, deliver best DEV diagnostic as research-only and preserve parent; do not promote defaults.
selection.policy: fixed argmax; action head authoritative; missing required slot rejects; never rescue intent from slot scores; no calibration or test retuning

evaluation.fresh_declared_voice_test: all new 440 tasks, only after immutable model/export lock
evaluation.legacy: official202 and original reserved cohorts exposed regression; report retained versus now-outside-demo populations separately
